title: Poland Reshapes Its Tax Code and Celebrates Growth · 29 Aug
keywords: Poland, tax reform, income tax, corporate tax, GDP growth, inflation, cost of living, National Bank of Poland, European Union, fiscal policy, bracket creep, middle class, Warsaw, economic outlook, złoty
notes: Poland is pushing through its most significant income-tax restructuring in years, raising relief thresholds for middle earners while lifting the corporate rate for large firms. At the same time, the economy expanded by 3.8 percent year-on-year in the second quarter of 2026, outpacing much of the European Union. Yet with inflation still hovering around 3 percent and core prices remaining sticky, many Polish households say the recovery does not yet feel real.
